title: AMD Ryzen 5 5500X3D Desktop Processor - Tray
body_html:
• 6 Cores & 12 Threads
  • Max Boost Clock: Up to 4.0 GHz
  • Supports DDR4
  • AM4 Socket

The AMD Ryzen 5 5500X3D is a powerful 6-core, 12-thread desktop processor built on AMD’s Zen 3 architecture for the AM4 platform. Designed primarily for gaming enthusiasts and budget-performance PC builds, it features AMD’s advanced 3D V-Cache technology with a massive 96MB L3 cache, delivering improved gaming performance and lower latency in demanding titles. With support for PCIe 4.0 and DDR4 memory, the Ryzen 5 5500X3D offers an excellent upgrade option for existing AM4 users who want high gaming performance without moving to the AM5 platform.
